name: @node-ctypes/smartcard
description: Typed portable PC/SC bindings and asynchronous smart card API powered by node-ctypes
author: Damiano Mazzella

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:types && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "tests/src/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:checks: npm run build && npm run test:types && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "tests/checks/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:checks:mirrored: npm run build && npm run test:types && node scripts/test-mirrored.ts "tests/checks/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:transactions: npm run build && npm run test:types && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/hardware/transactions.test.ts
scripts.test:mirrored: npm run build && npm run test:types && node scripts/test-mirrored.ts
